screen.objective: pooled-OOF blend logloss over selection folds (seed 42)

directives.from_scratch: calibration layer designed from scratch; every parameter (family, warmup, refit cadence, member scope) is a searched dimension
directives.machine_stable: num_threads=1 / n_jobs=1 + env pins (tune_xgb_lgbm_full module import)
directives.substrate: per-fold OOF member probs, production configs, static-50 refit point; within-arm deltas are on identical probabilities
directives.weights: blend weights re-earned causally on calibrated probs (production compute_adaptive_weights); fold 0 uses config.ENSEMBLE_WEIGHTS
directives.gates: member (ll/auc/ece both views) + blend (±0.001/ece) on 3-seed means; ADOPT only if all pass

verdict.summary: Causal member-level calibration layer (from-scratch search: platt/temperature x warmup 4-12 x refit 1-4 x scope xgb/lgb/en/xgb+lgb/all, 20 seeded TPE trials, top-4 confirmed on seeds 42/7/2026) FAILS the member and blend gates on both views. The in-sample Platt recovery (-0.0015, diag [4]) was an artifact of fitting and scoring the same window; under the production causal contract the calibrator fits prior folds miscalibration and applies it forward while the deformation drifts — degrading pooled selection logloss (+0.0005 best) and ECE (0.0123 -> 0.0180 best). Blend-level status quo stands.
verdict.consequence: xgboost ~1% blend weight is confirmed correct behavior: starvation of a member with drifting miscalibration, whose raw seal performance (best-tied ll 0.67580, best ECE 0.0155) is already competitive.
